subject: Sales→CS: Aperture AI handover — deployment constraints & owner nomination
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Li <jordan@aperture.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Aperture AI — handover and kickoff asks

Hi Jordan — great to get to the finish line with the Aperture AI contract. Attached is the draft SOW (Aperture_SOW_v1.pdf) and a short deployment matrix (redwood-deployment-matrix.md) that captures environment constraints we discussed on Friday. Key items for CS to validate during kickoff:

- Preferred go-live target: 2027-05-10 (approx 4 weeks)
- Primary workload: chat generation + embeddings (high throughput, 5k reqs/day expected)
- Data residency: US-east required; customer will request VPC-private deployment
- Security: customer expects SOC2 evidence and KMS integration; procurement flagged HSM for key custody
- Network: see network_requirements.xlsx for IP allowlist + egress needs

As discussed, we'd like Customer Success to own the implementation plan and technical onboarding. Can you confirm a CS owner + proposed S0 (kickoff agenda) before EOD Wednesday?

Procurement will be looping in a PO signature path — Jordan, looping them in here for timing.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Cc: Procurement <procurement@aperture.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture AI — handover and kickoff asks

Hi Alex — thanks, appreciate the clear summary and the SOW. A couple of quick clarifications from our side before CS kickoff:

1) KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys via AWS KMS. Is Redwood's Private deployment compatible with our KMS + HSM requirements?
2) SSO: We'll want SAML SSO for admin accounts. Any limitations on role mapping during first-week access?
3) Procurement timeline: We expect legal/PO to sign within 7–10 business days; we may request a temporary staging key until the PO clears.

If you can confirm the KMS and SSO path, we'll lock the kickoff date. Also happy to schedule a 30-minute tech pre-check with your CS to walk the network spreadsheet.

— Jordan
Jordan Li
Head of Platform, Aperture AI
jordan@aperture.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: INTERNAL: Aperture AI — pre-handoff notes

Alex / Karthik — internal run-through before I escalate to CS ops. Key risks and notes I captured from the sales thread:

- High throughput expectation (5k/day) — likely needs Dedicated or at least reserved burst capacity; finance will need to confirm commit.
- KMS/HSM ask: this will push them toward Private (VPC) unless we can offer a managed KMS bridge; security will flag if we propose a permanent managed key.
- Network allowlist includes multiple cloud IP ranges — potential gating item for on-prem-style customers with strict firewall rules.
- Procurement window may slip; recommend we propose a soft staging plan (30-day staging license) to avoid a hard start date.

Suggested CS kickoff owners: Neha Kapoor (primary) — experienced with Private deployments and KMS integrations; Monica Patel (secondary/contact for orchestration). Neha can lead the technical pre-check; Monica can run the kickoff agenda and acceptance criteria.

I'll add the S0 agenda items for acceptance criteria, technical pre-check, and security checklist. Forwarding to Alex to connect Monica/Neha to the customer.

— Marissa

Director, Customer Success (Sales-to-CS)
